transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

Well, I came in because... I don't know, ever since my sister and her baby moved back into our house, I've just been a lot more on edge and down than usual. I find myself snapping over really little things at home. And then by the time I get to my classes or the mechanic shop, I'm already completely drained. I mean, I'm still getting by, mostly, but I've missed a couple of deadlines recently. I even had to back out of helping build the set for the theater department because I just couldn't keep everything straight in my head anymore.
Have you been losing interest or pleasure in activities that you usually enjoy?

Not really, no. I still like doing the things I usually enjoy. Like, I still like working at the shop, and I actually really wanted to build that theater set. It's not that I don't care anymore... it's just that I'm too drained to actually do it right now with everything going on at the house. So, the interest is still there, I just don't have the energy.
Besides the situation at home, do you find yourself worrying excessively about many different areas of your life?

No, not really. I mean, I worry about getting my assignments done and doing a good job at work, but that's just normal stuff, you know? It's really just the situation at home that's got me so stressed out right now. It's not like I'm sitting around worrying about everything else in my life.
When did you first start feeling more on edge and down in relation to your sister and her baby moving into the house?

Well, I was doing fine before they got here. It really all started... I'd say within a couple of weeks of them moving in. Once the house got so crowded and noisy, that's when I started feeling this way.
Have you been feeling sad or down most of the day, nearly every day?

No, I wouldn't say that. I don't feel sad or down most of the day. I mean, I get frustrated and stressed out when I'm at the house because of all the noise and chaos, but it's not like a deep sadness that sticks with me all day long. Once I'm out of the house, like at work or school, my mood is usually fine. It's really just tied to being at home.
